lf-conversation-workspace.description: A worked package reader sharing Leaf conversations and obligations.

lf-x-margin.description: A worked page presentation: marks, thread cards and the comment box beside the page's content, drawn through the public package interface.
lf-x-margin.x-instructions: Use this only on a page whose body has data-annotations="page", once, as the last child of main.

lf-margin-entry-gallery.description: A developer exhibit of page-edge controls and status indicators across their supported states.
lf-margin-entry-gallery.x-instructions: Use this only in the feature gallery. Ordinary pages demonstrate controls through the live widgets that own them.

lf-document-gallery.description: A gallery producer whose changing Markdown is read by a text document.
